title: Overlays
summary: See-through graphics for footage in the editorial look: serif headlines that rise from behind a hairline, one big word, pull quotes and drop caps, Didone figures, contents and strike lists, contact sheets and a storyboard strip, typed note and comment cards, a follow button, and page furniture (running heads, folios, keylines, tags, a timecode). Paper cards with hairline edges in the footage's own colours. Defaults keep the middle of the frame (the face) clear.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"piece": "overlays/headline", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"lines": ["One message,", "a *finished* reel"], "y": 250}}. Positions are 1080x1920 frame pixels; *asterisks* mark the italic accent word in any text; each piece leaves before its end when the player passes `life`. Cards take field: paper (default), stone, blush, ink, wine. Ink type on bright footage, paper type on dark; headline, masthead and caption-rule lay their own soft veil. Kit: library/themes/editorial/kit.js.

items.name: Headline
items.description: A magazine headline over footage: a tracked kicker, a hairline that draws, serif lines that rise from behind it one after another; *marked* words are italic in the accent. A soft paper (or ink) veil keeps it readable. Props: kicker, lines, y, x, width, size, align, ground (paper|ink|none), folio.

items.name: Big word
items.description: One big serif word across the frame, its letters fading up one after another; optionally italic, with a kicker and hairline. Works with "behind": "person". Props: word, y (baseline), size, width, italic, color, kicker, step, x.

items.name: Pull quote
items.description: A pull quote on a paper card: a large Didone quotation mark in the accent, serif lines rising one after another, a hairline and a tracked attribution. Props: quote, by, x, y, w, size, field.

items.name: Drop cap
items.description: The opening paragraph of an article: a Didone drop cap in the accent and a few lines of serif that rise beside and under it. Props: kicker, text, x, y, w, size, field.

items.name: Picture caption
items.description: A picture caption: a hairline draws, a serif line rises above it, a tracked credit and a mono index sit beneath. Lower frame by default. Props: caption, sub, index, y, x0, x1, color (ink|paper), size, ground.

items.name: Byline
items.description: A byline strap: a paper strip glides in from the left edge with a tracked role over a hairline and a name in serif. Props: role, name, y, field, size.

items.name: Figure
items.description: A big Didone numeral that counts up on a small paper card, a tracked label above a hairline and an italic note beneath. Props: value, prefix, suffix, decimals, label, note, x, y, w, size, field, startAt, seconds.

items.name: By the numbers
items.description: Two to four Didone figures in a row over hairlines, counting up, a tracked label under each. With "use": "project" an item may name a key of the project's own counts (graphics, effects, transitions, zooms, layouts, sounds, changes, cuts, pauses, before, after). Props: title, items [{value|key, label, suffix, decimals}], x, y, w, field, note, use.

items.name: Swatches
items.description: The palette as printed colour chips that wipe down in turn, each with its name and hex value. Defaults are the theme's colours as measured on its footage. Props: title, chips [{color, name}], x, y, w, field, step.

items.name: Progress rule
items.description: A job in progress drawn as a rule: a serif label and a thick wine rule that fills past named stage ticks and stops at holdAt; no percentage is printed. Props: label, stages [{label, at}], startAt, seconds, holdAt, x, y, w, field, note.

items.name: Strike list
items.description: Things no longer needed: serif items rise one by one and a crimson rule draws through each at its strike time. Props: title, items [{label, at, strike, icon (app|timeline|file|clock)}], x, y, w, size, field, foot.

items.name: Contents
items.description: A contents page: numbered serif entries rise one per step with hairlines between; the newest (or `active`) entry carries full ink. Props: title, items, step, startAt, x, y, w, size, field, active.

items.name: Contact sheet
items.description: A contact sheet: a grid of small frames laid down one after another (your images, or tints of the footage) with mono frame numbers and a running counter. Props: title, note, count, cols, images, step, startAt, x, y, w, field, ratio, pick, pickAt.

items.name: Storyboard strip
items.description: A storyboard, shot by shot: a row of small frames, the current shot large beneath with its number and title, changing on each step; an editor's note types on beside a crimson margin rule and is marked applied. Props: title, kicker, shots [{title}], images, steps [{shot, at}], note {text, at, seconds, done}, x, y, w, big, field.

items.name: Screen push
items.description: A real screenshot on a paper card: rises in showing the whole screen, then pushes in on one region (focus, shares of the image) and keeps drifting, a crimson outline settling on it. Use for showing the actual tool, e.g. the editor's review page for this video.

items.name: View slam
items.description: Which posts worked, in your face: up to three rows of a cover thumbnail beside a huge serif figure that counts up as the row slams in; the biggest lands last in the accent colour with a Worked flag and a jolt. Real figures only.

items.name: Note card
items.description: One message, typed and sent: a paper card, a line of serif italic typing with a caret, and a round wine send button that fills with a tick. Props: label, done, text, typeAt, typeFor, sendAt, x, y, w, size, field, folio.

items.name: Comment card
items.description: A comment being left: the word typed in large Didone capitals with a caret, then posted; optionally a reply rises underneath. Props: label, text, name, typeAt, typeFor, postAt, reply {name, text, at}, x, y, w, size, field.

items.name: Follow card
items.description: A follow button being pressed: a paper pill with a monogram and handle; the wine Follow button becomes an outlined Following with a tick at pressAt. Props: handle, sub, initial, label, done, pressAt, x, y, w, field.

items.name: Margin note
items.description: An editor's note in the margin: a small paper slip with a tracked label and a line of italic, and a hairline with a dot that draws to the thing it is about. Props: label, note, x, y, w, to [x, y], size, field.

items.name: Running head
items.description: A running head: a hairline with a tracked section label at the left and a mono folio at the right, optionally a small Didone title above. Can run a whole clip. Props: left, right, title, y, color (ink|paper), ground.

items.name: Folio
items.description: A page number on a small tab in a corner: a Didone figure, a short hairline, a tracked section name. Props: index, total, label, x, y, align, field.

items.name: Keyline frame
items.description: A thin printed frame inside the picture that draws from a corner, with small tracked labels in up to four corners. Props: inset, top, bottom, color (paper|ink), labels, width.

items.name: Section tag
items.description: A small tracked label in a tight box that wipes open from the left, with an optional number. Props: text, number, x, y, field (ink|wine|paper|blush|crimson), size, align.

items.name: Timecode
items.description: A running mm:ss:ff timecode of the clip on a small ink tab with a tracked label and a slow dot. Props: label, fps, x, y, align, field, from.

items.name: Veil
items.description: A quiet ground for type on footage: a soft gradient of paper (or ink) from the top and/or bottom of the frame. Props: top, bottom, color, strength.

items.name: Cover field
items.description: A flat field of one of the theme's grounds fills the frame and a headline assembles on it fast: a rule snaps across, lines slide in from opposite sides out of a blur. Made for "behind": "person" (the speaker cut out in front of the field). Props: field, lines, left, right, y, size, step, at, slide, outAt.

items.name: Reel grid
items.description: A profile's grid of reels the way a phone shows it: three columns of 9:16 tiles with a small reel mark, under tab glyphs; tiles land fast, then the grid scrolls. No app logo or name, and no view counts unless `counts` is given. Props: title, note, images, count, startAt, step, scrollAt, scrollFor, rows, x, y, w, field, counts.

items.name: Beacon lamps
items.description: Two emergency lamps in the theme's line style, one red and one blue, lighting in turn with a soft turning wedge each; for the top corners, with the siren_beams effect. Props: left, right, size, rate, colors, reach.

items.name: Type takeover
items.description: The words are the picture: a sequence of steps, each replacing the one before on its beat, giant lines in the serif, its italic, Didone capitals or a heavy condensed grotesque on a flat field that can flip with every step, each landing with its own move (slam, roll, track, letters, cut). Made for "behind": "person". Props: steps [{at, field, y, gap, enter, lines [{text, face, color, max, width, swipe, caps}]}], left, right, headY, x, width.

items.name: Tile burst
items.description: A wall of pictures tiled edge to edge that bursts open: tiles are pulled away one after another, alternately up and down, onto what is underneath. For the first half second of a video. Props: images, cols, rows, startAt, step, out, gap, order.

items.name: Grid ground
items.description: One colour with subtle grid squares (graph paper) instead of a flat ground. Put it behind the clip's windows (behind: true).

items.name: AI assistant thread
items.description: A business's AI assistant answering customers: a paper card with a tracked label over a rule, customer messages sliding in left in a soft bubble, the assistant's replies typing on right in the accent with a small tag (Sales, Support). Props: label, messages [{from: them|bot, text, at, tag}], typeFor, x, y, w, size, field.

items.name: Phone app
items.description: Your own app on a flat ink phone: the phone rises in, the app name sets in serif, list rows slide in with mono figures, a wide accent button lands and is pressed. Flat and printed, no glass. Props: name, kicker, rows [{label, value}], button, x (centre), y (top), h, rowAt, step, pressAt.
